items.rationale: Accept easy. Tren, Tramvai and Metrou share the concrete rail-running predicate; Bicicletă does not. The three rail modes are independently familiar, with no competing trio as specific as the intended one.

Accept easy. Rain, snow and hail are familiar precipitation forms; wolf is a clear biological outsider. This is a deliberately accessible first-step classification, without an obscure exception or changing fact.

Accept easy. Cheek, eyelid and eyebrow are parts of the face; knee is a lower-limb part. All four are familiar body words, so the distinction requires the actual relation instead of recognition of only three words.
Accept easy. Thigh, lower leg and ankle are parts of the lower limb; nose is facial. The terminology remains common and the anatomical predicate resolves one unique intruder.
Accept easy. Root, branch and leaf are actual plant parts. Stone may occur beside a plant but is not one of its parts; the specific part-of predicate resolves that contextual association fairly.

Accept easy. Sofa, armchair and stool are furniture intended for sitting; tap is plumbing. Their common purpose is concrete and nameable, with the backless stool giving useful variety inside the trio.
Accept easy. Hammer, pliers and saw are manual workshop tools. Toothbrush is specifically for personal hygiene, unlike the previously discussed ruler that could fairly be a workshop tool.
Accept easy. Telemea, Urdă and Brânză de burduf are familiar cheese varieties; apricot is fruit. All intended members satisfy one culinary kind rather than regional association.
Accept easy. Amandină, Ecler and Savarină are familiar confectionery cakes; mustard is a savoury condiment. The label states a recognizable retail/food type rather than a technical recipe identity.
Accept easy. Compas, Echer and Raportor are instruments in the geometry kit; Mop is a cleaning tool. The trio has a specific shared school function, with no guess-dependent exception.
Accept easy. Sink, bathtub and tap are sanitary fixtures connected to water; clock is not. A clock may stand in a bathroom, but simple co-location does not satisfy the stated plumbing predicate.
Accept easy. Mop, broom and vacuum are routinely used to clean floors; fountain pen is for writing. The predicate includes different cleaning methods without implying they all work identically.

Accept easy. Shovel, rake and watering can are tools used in a garden; toothpaste is a hygiene consumable. The word unelte reasonably covers the watering implement and does not promise three soil-cutting tools.

Accept easy. Bear, fox and squirrel are familiar wild animals of Romanian forests; the ordinary domestic sheep is the outlier. The label explicitly supplies wild status, avoiding the weak claim that sheep can never enter woodland.
Accept easy. Cow, horse and goat are domestic animals raised around farms and households; wolf is wild. The display does not imply the three have identical diet or economic use.
Accept easy. Apple, pear and plum grow in orchards; carrot is a cultivated root vegetable. The everyday food senses are clear and there is no botanical tomato-style trap.

Accept easy. Second, minute and hour are duration units; ruler measures length rather than being a duration unit. Unlike a four-group abstract filler board, this short educational contrast directly tests a useful unit/instrument distinction.

Accept easy. Wardrobe, shelf and chest of drawers store objects; shampoo is a consumable. Shampoo may be stored in that furniture, which remains a different relation and cannot make it a storage object.

Accept easy. Wheat, barley and oats are cereals; vanilla is a flavouring crop. All are familiar ingredient words and the distinction is a true kind-of relation rather than assumed sweet-versus-savoury use.

Accept easy under the exact bound identities. Walnut, hazelnut and almond supply edible kernels enclosed in hard shells. The Cacao identity is explicitly food powder, which is not such a kernel. This judgment does not extend to a substituted cacao-plant or cacao-bean identity and does not classify almonds as botanical nuts.

Accept easy. Trousers, dress and skirt are clothing; comb is a grooming implement. All are concrete everyday objects and the intended group is uniquely identifiable without a hidden brand or fashion convention.

Accept easy. Blanket, sheet and carpet are household textiles; hammer is a tool. The floor textile does not have to be bed linen, because the label correctly names the wider shared material/use class.

Accept easy. Roof, wall and ceiling form part of a house construction; motorcycle is a vehicle. The difference is about structural function, not whether an item could physically be kept inside a home.

Accept easy. Sadness, fear and anger are emotions; hunger is a physiological need. All four are commonly described feelings, so the more precise emotion label resolves the superficially plausible alternative grouping.

Accept easy. Sun, Moon and star are celestial bodies; carrot is not. The Sun also being a star creates nested membership inside the same intended category, not an alternative intruder or false scientific distinction.

Accept normal. Whipped cream/qualified whipping cream, soap/towel, bed/mattress and yeast/bread each form an ordinary functional association. The two food pairs do not support a comparably strong complete cross-matching: yeast does not make whipped cream, and whipping cream is not the defining source of bread.

Accept normal. Garcea/Mugur Mihăescu is the actor-role anchor; clock/hour and flowerpot/watering can are familiar practical pairs. Roe deer/deer are correctly paired as cervids, not falsely described as male and female of one species. No second performer or fictional role creates a mirror.

Accept normal. Popovici/swimming, bulb/light switch, train/station and Caragiale/O scrisoare pierdută are individually legible. Athlete/discipline and writer/work have different, recognizable counterpart types, so pairing the two people would strand incompatible remaining tiles.

Accept normal. Salt/brine, grandmother/grandfather, fork/spoon and Brâncuși/Domnișoara Pogany are precise enough to recover uniquely. Culinary tools and the salt solution share a broad meal context but cannot be exchanged into an equally plausible complete matching.

Accept normal. Eminescu/Floare albastră, two cheese types, two eye-area facial parts and flour/dough have clear independent relationships. Flour may occur in foods with cheese, but the displayed cheese-cheese and ingredient-dough pairs are far more specific than such co-occurrence.

Accept normal. Brother/sister, bicycle/motorcycle, hammer/nail and cloud/rain are familiar, independent pairs. The bicycle and motorcycle are the ordinary two-wheel forms; niche variants do not make the board misleading. No extra family or transport tiles permit a competing partition.

Accept normal for the displayed actor/character association. Heel/ankle, sofa/armchair and apple/pear provide clear anchors; Bobiță/Mihai Bobonete is ordinary television-role recognition. Bound KG descriptions mention a pub occupation, but neither displayed pair label nor the solution requires alcohol knowledge or adult framing; this is not permission for a pub-themed derivative.

Accept normal. Calendar/year, husband/wife, Halep/Wimbledon 2019 and barley/oats are independent. The calendar uses its ordinary annual sense; the tennis achievement is a fixed historical pairing. The additional female name cannot create a valid marriage-based alternative with the remaining event.

Accept normal. Sink/tap, book/reading, lightning/thunder and toothbrush/toothpaste are everyday counterparts. The two hygiene/water pairs retain distinctive functional partners rather than one generic bathroom category.

Accept normal with the culinary shell/kernel label. Rain/snow, wheat/semolina, skirt/dress and walnut/almond are recognizable. The milling relationship distinguishes the cereal pair from edible kernels; the wording does not assert that almonds are botanical nuts.

Accept normal. Ruler/set square, shoe/sock, bed/pillow and Creangă/Capra cu trei iezi are immediate concrete associations. School instruments do not create a second credible pairing for the writer and story, and there is only one author/work pair.

Accept normal. Mother/father, socket/plug, Porumbescu/Balada pentru vioară and minute/second are specific pairs. The two time units have an exact conversion; no second composer or music title creates the known cross-author ambiguity.

Accept normal. Wardrobe/shelf, comb/shampoo, watering can/water and pancakes/jam are legible. Water can be used while washing hair, but swapping it into that pair strands the watering can; no equally defensible complete alternative exists.

Accept normal. Knife/bread, Slavici/Moara cu noroc, Neagu/handball and cocoa/chocolate each have a clear purpose, attribution or ingredient relation. The sports statement is a stable discipline identity, without an outdated present-tense employment or retirement claim.

Accept normal. Cooker/frying pan, sarmale/cabbage, Coandă/eponymous effect and vacuum/dust are specific. Cabbage leaves are a standard sarmale wrapper; the label does not claim every sarmale recipe must use cabbage. Shared kitchen context does not support an equivalent alternative mapping.

Accept normal. Polenta/cornmeal, lower leg/knee, mujdei/garlic and Piersic/Mărgelatu pair naturally. Polenta can accompany garlic sauce, but swapping the two finished foods would leave cornmeal/garlic without a comparable defining relationship; ingredient pairs remain uniquely preferable.

Accept normal. Library/book, cup/tea, screwdriver/screw and oven/baking tray are concrete counterpart relationships. The library uses the public-place sense supported by its exact identity. Kitchen objects have different uses and do not permit an equally natural cross-matching.

Accept normal. Notebook/pen, broom/dustpan, Enescu/Rapsodia Română and Amandină/Ecler are recognizable. The composer title is kept apart from Porumbescu, avoiding the real same-title ambiguity; the remaining practical and confectionery pairs do not compete.

Accept normal. Pencil/eraser, mop/bucket, mustard/mici and window/mirror each have familiar partners. Cleaning can involve glass surfaces, but pairing a mop with a window strands bucket/mirror; the intended full matching remains the uniquely coherent one.

Accept normal. Glass/water, Racoviță/speleology, root/branch and Comăneci/first Olympic perfect ten are distinct. Water/plant association is too broad to displace glass/water while leaving an equally good match for the glass, and the two famous people have unmistakably different counterparts.

Accept easy. Stilou, Radieră and Riglă are familiar school supplies with different clear functions; Cană is a drinking vessel. A mug may occur at school, but location does not make it a school supply. The precise inlier predicate yields the strongest ordinary three-word grouping. No identical trio or near-duplicate board was found; maximum overlap with existing Intrusul boards is one word.

Accept easy. Tigaie, Oală and Castron are all vessels that hold food; Cuțit is a cutting tool. All four belong naturally in a kitchen, so the player must identify the specific vessel distinction rather than choose a thematically unrelated word. Cooking versus serving does not produce an equally precise alternative trio. None of these four words is reused in an existing Intrusul board.

Accept easy. Camion, Microbuz and Dubă use roads; Tren uses rails. The infrastructure distinction is definitional and immediately nameable. I considered goods versus passengers as an alternate reading: the generic Tren label includes both passenger and freight trains, so it does not establish an exclusive cargo trio. This is a weaker alternative than the exact road/rail split. Maximum old-board overlap is one word and the inlier trio is new.

Accept easy. Găină–Ou, Lampă–Bec, Supă–Lingură and Aeroport–Avion are familiar, distinctive everyday pairings. The last three pairs provide firm anchors; possible food associations between hen, egg and soup cannot produce a second complete defensible matching because the spoon then loses its natural partner. Labels state ordinary associations without requiring specialist exceptions. All four intended pairs are new; the graph has no on-board cross edges.

Accept easy. Dinte–Periuță de dinți, Mop–Podea, copac–Rădăcină and Cumpărături–magazin have clear functions or part/whole relationships. Dinte–Rădăcină is a real secondary association worth testing, but choosing it strands copac and Periuță de dinți; it does not yield an equally defensible complete matching. No knowledge of the hidden KG descriptions is needed. All four pairs are new, and independent graph checks confirm only the intended four on-board links.

Accept corrected v2. Școală–A învăța and Ceas–Minut provide clear activity/time anchors. Morcov–Iepure is explicitly a familiar cultural association; the wording makes no claim about an animal's necessary, preferred or healthy diet. The exact floare snapshot denotes a reproductive plant organ, so the corrected label 'Floare și recipient pentru planta ei' preserves that sense instead of falsely calling the organ a whole plant. Ghiveci de flori also disambiguates the vessel from the dish. School/clock or carrot/flower co-occurrence cannot form a credible second complete matching. All four intended pairs are new and no on-board cross edges occur.
